 One day competition on “Reduce, Reuse and Recycle: Alternatives for waste management”  for club 
members sponsored by SPICES an AICTE initiative organized by Arts & Crafts club.

Event Description:  
 One day competition on “Reduce, Reuse and Recycle: Alternatives for waste management” for club 
members sponsored by SPICES an AICTE initiative organized by Arts & Crafts club. The chief guest Dr.  N. 
Sudhakar Reddy, Principal, SVCE  explained the spirit of competition, the impact of waste material and how to 
manage it through reusing and recycling. The club members bought some waste materials  to reuse such as tires, 
pots, plastic spoons, grass trays, card boards, old bike spares, empty banner cloth, CDs, Fevicryl A crylic paints 
and brushes according to their ideas. 
  With the guidance of club faculty coordinators , students prepared different  toys and crafts listed below: 
A small tower with  tires locating beautiful doll on the top , Photo frames, Tire clock, Ring bike, Canvas ban ner 

with quotations etc. Students learned the techniques in making waste material attractive and reusing. All the 
club members participated actively and enjoyed the competition. Prizes  were distributed to the best performers.  
Targeted Audience:  
1st,2nd and 3rdYear Students.
